# ce:compound support files

This folder holds the local support files used by the compound workflow:

- `references/schema.yaml` — frontmatter fields and enum values
- `references/yaml-schema.md` — category mapping for `docs/solutions/`
- `assets/resolution-template.md` — section structure for new solution docs

These files keep the compound workflow self-contained in this repo without copying the skill or
agent bundles.
